content: स्थिर {%a.%} [स्था-किरच्] (<ab>compar.</ab> स्थेयस्; <ab>superl.</ab> स्थेष्ठ) .²1 Firm, steady, fixed; भावस्थिराणि जननान्तरसौहृदानि <ls>Ś. 5. 2</ls>; स स्थाणुः स्थिरभक्तियोगसुलभो निःश्रेयसायास्तु वः <ls>V. 1. 1</ls>; <ls>Ku. 1. 30</ls>; <ls>R. 11. 19</ls>. .²2 Immoveable, still, motionless; स्थिरप्रदीपतामेत्य भुजङ्गाः पर्युपासते <ls>Ku. 2. 38</ls>. .²3 Immoveably fixed; कालेनावरणात्ययात्परिणते यत्स्नेहसारे स्थितम् <ls>U. 1. 39</ls>. .²4 Permanent, eternal, everlasting; कल्पिष्यन्ते स्थिरगणपदप्राप्तये श्रद्दधानाः <ls>Me. 57</ls>; <ls>Māl. 10. 25</ls>. .²5 Cool, collected, composed, placid, calm. .²6 Quiescent, free from passion. .²7 Steady in conduct, steadfast. .²8 Constant, faithful, determined. .²9 Certain, sure. .²10 Hard, solid. .²11 Strong, intense. .²12 Stern, relentless, hard-hearted; अहो स्थिरः कोऽपि तवेप्सितो युवा <ls>Ku. 5. 47</ls>. .{@-रः@} .²1 A god, deity. .²2 A tree. .²3 A mountain. .²4 A bull. .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of Śiva. .²6 <ab>N.</ab> of Kārtikeya. .²7 Final beatitude or absolution. .²8 The planet Saturn. .²9 <ab>N.</ab> of certain zodiacal signs ({%Taurus, Leo, Scorpio%}, and {%Aquarius%}). .{@-रा@} .²1 The earth; पितामहस्तामालोक्य विहस्तामस्थिरां स्थिराम् <ls>Śiva B. 5. 47</ls>. .²2 A strong-minded woman. .²3 The silk-cotton tree. .{@-रम्@} Steadfastness, stubbornness. (स्थिरीकृ means .²1 to confirm, strengthen, or to corroborate. .²2 to stop, make fast. .²3 to cheer up, console, comfort; <ls>Ś. 4</ls>. .²4 To steel (the heart); <ls>Amaru.</ls> स्थिरीभू means .²1 to become firm or steady. .²2 to become calm or tranquil.)
